answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 182547 Country: India Title: Starting Ghusl without performing wudhu Question: Can I start ghusl (after having janabat) without performing wudhu? Is it mandatory to perform wudhu before ghusl? Answer ID: 182547 Posted on: Aug 15, 2021 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1082/684/SN=1/1443) It is masnoon to perform wudhu before ghusl janabat. If a person performs ghusl janabat without performing wudhu, he will still attain purity. However, he will be deprived of the virtue of the sunnah of wudhu. وسننه كسنن الوضوء .... البداءة بغسل يديه و فرجه ... وخبت بدنه إن كان عليه خبث لئلا يشيع ثم تؤضأ، أطلقه فانصرف إلى الكامل الخ (در مختار مع رد المحتار 1/292، كتاب الطهارة، مطبوعه: مكتبه زكريا،ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
